name: Co-Working Spaces / Incubators / Accelerators Subsidy Scheme
agency: Startup and IT Promotion Cell (SITPC), Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communications, Government of Goa
target_group: SITPC-certified start-ups taking seats at co-working spaces, incubators or accelerators listed by SITPC
eligibility: Start-up certified by SITPC; payment to the listed co-working space/incubator/accelerator must be digital (SITPC may admit otherwise per guidelines); start-up bank account linked to Aadhaar; address proof of an operational office in Goa; bank account in Goa.
benefit: Reimbursement of 50% of per-seat cost at SITPC-listed spaces: max INR 3,000 per seat at co-working spaces (up to 2 years), INR 5,000 per seat at incubators (up to 1 year), INR 6,000 per seat at accelerators (up to 3 months); cap of 8 seats per start-up; 100 co-working seats and 50 seats each at incubators and accelerators subsidised per year; SITPC may reimburse up to 100% for deserving start-ups per its internal guidelines. Benefits are not an entitlement; SITPC reserves the sole right to accept or reject applications.
how_to_apply: Apply online via Goa Online startup login (https://goaonline.gov.in/public/startuplogin?_d=IFT&_s=IFT1901). DPIIT-recognised startups can apply directly for all Goa Startup Policy 2021 schemes via Startup India login on the portal.
documents: Address proof of operational office in Goa (utility bill not older than 2 months); agreement between the start-up and the co-working space/incubator/accelerator; cancelled cheque of the start-up (bank account in Goa).
valid_period: Goa Startup Policy 2021: three years from date of Gazette notification (date not stated on portal). Goa Startup Policy 2025 (three years from its Gazette notification; date not stated) grandfathers startups registered under the 2021 and 2017 policies.
notes: max_rupees is the largest per-seat cap (INR 6,000 per seat, accelerators). 2017-policy scheme PDF (Incentives/Co-WorkingSpaceSubsidyScheme.pdf, SPC) has the same per-seat figures. Listed in Goa Startup Policy 2025 as 'Co-working Space/ Incubators/ Subsidy Scheme'. List of co-working spaces: https://startup.goa.gov.in/List-of-Co-working-spaces.pdf (12 spaces incl. FiiRE, CIBA, 91springboard, MeWo, Clay). Read from Wayback snapshot of StartupIncentives.html dated 2025-06-17 (live site TLS certificate expired on 2026-11-02).

name: Salary Reimbursement Scheme
agency: Startup and IT Promotion Cell (SITPC), Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communications, Government of Goa
target_group: SITPC-certified start-ups hiring local freshers or employing a workforce of 60% or more locals
eligibility: Start-up certified by SITPC with a valid start-up certificate number (Goa Startup Policy 2021); directors' bank accounts linked to Aadhaar; only expenditure incurred after notification of Goa Start-up Policy 2021, within its validity and paid digitally (SITPC may admit non-digital payments at its discretion). Employees hired for at least 12 months; for the fresher clause the employee must be a professional; employees' and directors' bank accounts linked to Aadhaar. Fresher = graduate/postgraduate who completed studies in the stipulated period and not more than 2 years ago. Local = born in Goa, or domiciled 10+ years, or spouse of such a person through a marriage registered in Goa.
benefit: (1) 50% of salary of local freshers reimbursed, capped at INR 15,000 per month per recruit, for up to 25 people per month for 3 years; available to 100 start-ups per year. (2) Start-ups whose workforce is 60% local: up to 25% of local workforce salary reimbursed, capped at INR 25 lakh per year, for 3 years, up to 25 people; 100 start-ups per year. Benefits are not an entitlement; SITPC reserves the sole right to accept or reject applications.
how_to_apply: Apply online via Goa Online startup login (https://goaonline.gov.in/public/startuplogin?_d=IFT&_s=IFT2101).
documents: Address proof of operational office in Goa; cancelled cheque; bank certification/statement showing salary debit; degree certificates of employees; Aadhaar of employees; employment contracts; Goan proof (birth certificate); HR letter certifying contracts meet policy conditions; Aadhaar of Director/CEO; salary increment letter of each employee.
valid_period: Goa Startup Policy 2021: three years from date of Gazette notification (date not stated on portal). Goa Startup Policy 2025 (three years from its Gazette notification; date not stated) grandfathers startups registered under the 2021 and 2017 policies.
notes: max_rupees = INR 25 lakh per year cap (clause 2). 2017-policy version (Incentives/SalaryReimbursementScheme.pdf, SPC) capped freshers at INR 10,000 per month. Goa Startup Policy 2025 clause 5.4.1(d): fresher cap INR 15,000/month; local-workforce matching grant up to 25% of salary capped at INR 10,000 per month per recruit for a maximum of 3 years. Read from Wayback snapshot of StartupIncentives.html dated 2025-06-17 (live site TLS certificate expired on 2026-11-02).

name: Reimbursement of Expenses for Startups Operating from Leased / Privately Owned Premises Scheme (internet, software, cloud and lease rental subsidy)
agency: Startup and IT Promotion Cell (SITPC), Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communications, Government of Goa
target_group: SITPC-certified start-ups operating from their own or rented premises and not using government co-working spaces/incubators/accelerators; lease rental subsidy only for local start-ups
eligibility: Start-up certified by SITPC with a valid start-up certificate number (Goa Startup Policy 2021); directors' bank accounts linked to Aadhaar; only expenditure incurred after notification of Goa Start-up Policy 2021, within its validity and paid digitally (SITPC may admit non-digital payments at its discretion). Not using any government-developed co-working space/incubator/accelerator. Lease rental subsidy only for Local start-ups (at least 50% equity held continuously by Goans since inception) and only for two years. A start-up may avail either the own-premises or the rented-premises clause at a time.
benefit: Internet connectivity, software licence and cloud services costs reimbursed up to INR 1 lakh per quarter for one year (20 start-ups per year, whether own or rented premises). Local start-ups in rented premises additionally get a lease rental subsidy of up to INR 20 per sq ft per month, reimbursed quarterly for up to two years, capped at INR 3 lakh per annum (25 start-ups per year). Benefits are not an entitlement; SITPC reserves the sole right to accept or reject applications.
how_to_apply: Apply online via Goa Online startup login (https://goaonline.gov.in/public/startuplogin?_d=IFT&_s=IFT6301).
documents: Address proof of operational office in Goa; cancelled cheque; Goan domicile/residence certificate of 10 years; Aadhaar of Director/CEO; bills/invoices from vendors; proof of payment towards lease, cloud, internet and software; valid registered lease deed; software licence details.
valid_period: Goa Startup Policy 2021: three years from date of Gazette notification (date not stated on portal). Goa Startup Policy 2025 (three years from its Gazette notification; date not stated) grandfathers startups registered under the 2021 and 2017 policies.
notes: max_rupees = INR 3 lakh per annum lease-rental cap; the internet/software/cloud component is capped at INR 1 lakh per quarter. Same figures in the 2017-policy PDF (Incentives/ExpensesforStartupsScheme.pdf) and in Goa Startup Policy 2021 cl. 5.4.1(e)-(f) and 2025 cl. 5.4.1(e)-(f), where the 2025 policy lists a separate 'Lease Subsidy Scheme'. Read from Wayback snapshot of StartupIncentives.html dated 2025-06-17 (live site TLS certificate expired on 2026-11-02).

name: Seed Capital Scheme (Seed Capital Grant)
agency: Startup and IT Promotion Cell (SITPC), Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communications, Government of Goa
target_group: SITPC-certified start-ups with a promising idea / minimum viable product
eligibility: Start-up certified by SITPC with a valid start-up certificate number; directors' bank accounts linked to Aadhaar. Selection by SITPC due diligence and guidelines, including presentation to a panel of experts.
benefit: One-time grant of up to INR 10 lakh as determined by SITPC; 100 start-ups per year. Benefits are not an entitlement; SITPC reserves the sole right to accept or reject applications.
how_to_apply: Apply online via Goa Online startup login (https://goaonline.gov.in/public/startuplogin?_d=IFT&_s=IFT2201).
documents: Address proof of operational office in Goa; cancelled cheque; CV of founder in World Bank CV format; presentation to panel of experts; detailed plan of action to create a Minimum Viable Product.
valid_period: Goa Startup Policy 2021: three years from date of Gazette notification (date not stated on portal). Goa Startup Policy 2025 (three years from its Gazette notification; date not stated) grandfathers startups registered under the 2021 and 2017 policies.
notes: Identical in the 2017-policy PDF (Incentives/SeedCapitalScheme.pdf). Goa Startup Policy 2025 cl. 5.4.1(j): 'Seed Capital Grant Scheme' one-time grant up to Rs 10 lakh for startups with a promising MVP. Events page notes Bodhami (National Startup Awards 2020 winner) as a Seed Capital Grant beneficiary. Read from Wayback snapshot of StartupIncentives.html dated 2025-06-17 (live site TLS certificate expired on 2026-11-02).

name: IPR Reimbursement Scheme (patent / intellectual property cost reimbursement)
agency: Startup and IT Promotion Cell (SITPC), Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communications, Government of Goa
target_group: SITPC-certified start-ups filing national or international IP for technology-based products/services
eligibility: Start-up certified by SITPC with a valid start-up certificate number (Goa Startup Policy 2021); directors' bank accounts linked to Aadhaar; only expenditure incurred after notification of Goa Start-up Policy 2021, within its validity and paid digitally (SITPC may admit non-digital payments at its discretion). IP must be for a technology-based product/service or use technology to enhance an existing one; mandatory government and attorney fees must have been paid; one-time payment per IP application; rejected if reimbursement for the same IP was claimed under any Central or other State scheme; disbursed by seniority / SITPC recommendation subject to State budget.
benefit: Up to 100% of fees and all other costs of the IP application reimbursed, whether or not the IP is finally registered, capped at INR 2 lakh for national IP and INR 5 lakh for international IP; up to 200 start-ups per year. Benefits are not an entitlement; SITPC reserves the sole right to accept or reject applications.
how_to_apply: Apply online via Goa Online startup login (https://goaonline.gov.in/public/startuplogin?_d=IFT&_s=IFT2401).
documents: Copy of successful IP registration; original proof of payment with detailed statement of expenses; invoices/receipts from the competent authority and legal counsel; detailed report; address proof of operational office in Goa; cancelled cheque.
valid_period: Goa Startup Policy 2021: three years from date of Gazette notification (date not stated on portal). Goa Startup Policy 2025 (three years from its Gazette notification; date not stated) grandfathers startups registered under the 2021 and 2017 policies.
notes: 2017-policy version (Incentives/IPRReimbursementScheme.pdf) reimbursed only 50%, and only if the IP was registered successfully, same caps. Goa Startup Policy 2025 cl. 5.4.1(b) ('Intellectual Property Rights Scheme'): up to 100% of patent costs, caps Rs 2 lakh national / Rs 5 lakh international. Read from Wayback snapshot of StartupIncentives.html dated 2025-06-17 (live site TLS certificate expired on 2026-11-02).

name: Trademark Reimbursement Scheme
agency: Startup and IT Promotion Cell (SITPC), Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communications, Government of Goa
target_group: SITPC-certified start-ups in the production/service delivery phase registering their company name and logo as a trademark
eligibility: Start-up certified by SITPC with a valid start-up certificate number (Goa Startup Policy 2021); directors' bank accounts linked to Aadhaar; only expenditure incurred after notification of Goa Start-up Policy 2021, within its validity and paid digitally (SITPC may admit non-digital payments at its discretion). The start-up must have successfully registered its trademark.
benefit: 50% of the cost of trademark registration of company name and logo reimbursed, up to INR 25,000; up to 200 applicants per year. Benefits are not an entitlement; SITPC reserves the sole right to accept or reject applications.
how_to_apply: Apply online via Goa Online startup login (https://goaonline.gov.in/public/startuplogin?_d=IFT&_s=IFT1701).
documents: Address proof of operational office in Goa; cancelled cheque; company logo design; trademark certificate; copy of trademark application form and attachments; bills/invoices; proof of payment.
valid_period: Goa Startup Policy 2021: three years from date of Gazette notification (date not stated on portal). Goa Startup Policy 2025 (three years from its Gazette notification; date not stated) grandfathers startups registered under the 2021 and 2017 policies.
notes: Same figures in the 2017-policy PDF (Incentives/TrademarkReimbursementScheme.pdf). Goa Startup Policy 2025 cl. 5.4.1(c): 50% up to INR 25,000, covering search, filing, attorney, maintenance and legal fees, for a maximum of two trademark applications per startup. Read from Wayback snapshot of StartupIncentives.html dated 2025-06-17 (live site TLS certificate expired on 2026-11-02).

name: Grant for Incubation Centers within Educational Institutes Scheme (Incubator Grant Scheme)
agency: Startup and IT Promotion Cell (SITPC), Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communications, Government of Goa
target_group: Educational institutes in Goa affiliated to a recognised public university setting up or expanding an incubator on campus
eligibility: Educational institute in Goa affiliated to a recognised public university; incubation facilities cannot be restricted to the institute's own students; maximum 15 institutes per year; preference to well-performing applicants for the operational grant. Goa Startup Policy 2025 adds: each incubation centre must set up a Student Innovation and Entrepreneurship Council and submit quarterly progress reports on incubatee startups to SITPC.
benefit: One-time grant of up to INR 10 lakh towards capital expenses for setting up (or expanding) an incubator on campus; plus up to INR 3 lakh per year for three years towards operational expenses for institutes with existing incubation facilities. Benefits are not an entitlement; SITPC reserves the sole right to accept or reject applications.
how_to_apply: Apply online via Goa Online login (https://goaonline.gov.in/public/login?_d=IFT&_s=IFT1501), the same link as 'Register as Incubator'.
documents: Address proof of operational office in Goa; cancelled cheque; copy of plan of proposed expenditure; capital expenses as per Accounting Standard 101 (Fixed Assets) of the Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
valid_period: Goa Startup Policy 2021: three years from date of Gazette notification (date not stated on portal). Goa Startup Policy 2025 (three years from its Gazette notification; date not stated) grandfathers startups registered under the 2021 and 2017 policies.
notes: Same figures in the 2017-policy PDF (Incentives/IncubatorGrantScheme.pdf), Goa Startup Policy 2021 cl. 5.3.4 and Goa Startup Policy 2025 cl. 5.3.4 ('Incubator Grant Scheme'). Read from Wayback snapshot of StartupIncentives.html dated 2025-06-17 (live site TLS certificate expired on 2026-11-02).

name: R&D Reimbursement Scheme
agency: Startup and IT Promotion Cell (SITPC), Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communications, Government of Goa
target_group: Local (Goan-majority-owned) SITPC-certified start-ups in the R&D stage employing PhD or Master's degree holders
eligibility: Local start-up (at least 50% equity held continuously by Goans since inception) certified by SITPC; applicable only to Goans and local start-ups; directors' and employees' bank accounts linked to Aadhaar; employees hired for at least 12 months and holding a PhD or Master's degree (or equivalent) from a government-recognised institute; start-up in the R&D stage developing technology/products in the policy's domains, with a working prototype; preference to those with a patent applied/obtained; R&D expenses per Cost Accounting Standard 18; expenditure after notification of Goa Start-up Policy 2021, paid digitally.
benefit: 50% of R&D expenses, including salaries of PhD and Master's degree holders, reimbursed for two years, capped at INR 5 lakh per annum, of which the salary component may not exceed INR 2 lakh; up to 100 start-ups per year. Benefits are not an entitlement; SITPC reserves the sole right to accept or reject applications.
how_to_apply: Apply online via Goa Online startup login (https://goaonline.gov.in/public/startuplogin?_d=IFT&_s=IFT2001).
documents: Aadhaar of Director/CEO; documents of PhD salaried employees; HR letter certifying contracts meet policy conditions; contracts of employment (at least 12 months); salary slips; bank certification/statement showing salary debit; research proposal detailing relevance and application; copy of research work; original proof of payment of R&D per Cost Accounting Standard 18.
valid_period: Goa Startup Policy 2021: three years from date of Gazette notification (date not stated on portal). Goa Startup Policy 2025 (three years from its Gazette notification; date not stated) grandfathers startups registered under the 2021 and 2017 policies.
notes: 2017-policy PDF (Incentives/R&DReimbursementScheme.pdf) covered PhD holders only. Goa Startup Policy 2025 cl. 5.4.1(g) keeps 50% / Rs 5 lakh per annum / Rs 2 lakh salary cap for two years. Read from Wayback snapshot of StartupIncentives.html dated 2025-06-17 (live site TLS certificate expired on 2026-11-02).

name: Skill Development Promotion Scheme
agency: Startup and IT Promotion Cell (SITPC), Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communications, Government of Goa
target_group: Retail educational institutes / learning centres in Goa imparting programming and technical skills at pre-fixed rates, listed by SITPC
eligibility: Educational institute listed by SITPC with a valid Startup Cell Registration Number; at least one established learning centre in Goa recognised by an authorised government body (AICTE, UGC, NBA etc. as applicable); preference to institutes with OEM tie-ups; employees' and directors' bank accounts linked to Aadhaar; expenditure from one year before notification of Goa Start-up Policy 2021, within its validity, paid digitally; courses in the technical areas of Annexure 2.
benefit: Internet subsidy up to INR 5 lakh per year for two years; power subsidy up to INR 1 lakh per year for two years; 25% capital investment reimbursement up to INR 5 lakh over two years; 10% salary cost subsidy up to INR 3 lakh for two years; aggregate benefit capped at INR 10 lakh per year; up to 10 institutes per year; eligibility reviewed yearly on performance. Benefits are not an entitlement; SITPC reserves the sole right to accept or reject applications.
how_to_apply: Apply online via Goa Online startup login (https://goaonline.gov.in/public/startuplogin?_d=IFT&_s=IFT2301).
documents: Aadhaar of relevant employees; contracts of employment; salary slips; bank certification/statement showing salary debit; original bills from service providers/OEMs/authorised vendors; authorisation letter from OEM.
valid_period: Goa Startup Policy 2021: three years from date of Gazette notification (date not stated on portal). Goa Startup Policy 2025 (three years from its Gazette notification; date not stated) grandfathers startups registered under the 2021 and 2017 policies.
notes: Same figures in the 2017-policy PDF (Incentives/SkillDevelopmentPromotionScheme.pdf) and Goa Startup Policy 2021 section 6(a). Not carried into the 12-scheme list of Goa Startup Policy 2025. Read from Wayback snapshot of StartupIncentives.html dated 2025-06-17 (live site TLS certificate expired on 2026-11-02).

name: Technology Fellowship and Patent Promotion Scheme
agency: Startup Promotion Cell (SPC), Department of Information Technology, Government of Goa
target_group: Technology educators in technical educational institutes in Goa wishing to specialise in IoT, AI, ML, interaction design, big data, robotics, 3-D printing, data science, drones, VR/AR/MR
eligibility: All technology educators in technical educational institutes in Goa; selected by SPC and a panel of evaluators after interview/presentation; must secure admission to a recognised summer/winter/FPD course at an institute listed by SPC; bond (Annexure 3) to be furnished; grant utilisation certificate within 3 months of course completion; patent grant claimable once per policy period.
benefit: Educational grant of INR 10 lakh per year for five years to attend summer schools/short-term programmes at Centres of Excellence in India or abroad; up to ten fellows per year (one per focus area); fellows act as master trainers/mentors in Centres of Excellence/Advanced Maker Labs. Patent-specific grant of up to INR 15 lakh for business- and value-driven patents registered by the fellow. Approval/rejection within 45 days; disbursement within 60 days of approval.
how_to_apply: Apply directly to SPC in the prescribed format with a statement of purpose and work plan, at any time of year aligned with the target programme's deadlines; shortlisted applicants interviewed by SPC and panel.
documents: CV with publications, working papers, awards and grants; acceptance letter to the programme; research proposal with market potential; statement of purpose; recommendation letter from institute/university; plan of action to apply the learning in Goa; fee schedule; copy of patent registration certificate (for patent grant); cancelled cheque (no cooperative bank accounts); bond (Annexure 2/3).
valid_period: Goa Start-up Policy 2017: three years from notification (policy unveiled September 2017 per About Us page).
portal_section: Startup Incentives (2017 scheme PDF; anchor 'Technology Fellowship and Patent Promotion Scheme' on home page)
notes: Scheme document framed under Goa Start-up Policy 2017 (SPC). The home page (2026-09 snapshot) still links this scheme by anchor, but the current StartupIncentives page carries no section for it. Goa Startup Policy 2021 section 6(d) only says the cell will 'jointly run a technology fellowship program'. Read from Wayback snapshot of the PDF dated 2020-11-26.

name: Skill Development Fee Reimbursement Scheme
agency: Startup Promotion Cell (SPC), Department of Information Technology, Government of Goa
target_group: Students (Goan-born, Goa-domiciled, or studying in Goa) completing SPC-approved technical skill training at a Goan educational institute
eligibility: Student = born in Goa or domiciled 10+ years (studying anywhere) or non-domicile studying in Goa; currently pursuing graduation or within two years of the graduate degree; course must be SPC-approved, in the technical domains of Goa Start-up Policy 2017 (Annexure 2), at an institute incorporated or with a registered place of business in Goa; expenditure after policy notification, paid digitally; apply within 6 months of the expense.
benefit: Reimbursement of 50% of course fees up to INR 50,000 per student for successfully completed SPC-approved technical skill training; up to two courses per student per year; up to 1,000 students per year. Approval/rejection within 45 days; disbursement within 60 days of approval.
how_to_apply: Submit the application form (Annexure 1) with course completion certificate and documents to SPC by e-mail or on the web portal, within 6 months of incurring the expense.
documents: Aadhaar card of the student; course completion certificate; copy of SPC approval of the programme; original proof of payment / fee receipt; cancelled cheque (no cooperative bank accounts); Annexure 1 form.
valid_period: Goa Start-up Policy 2017: three years from notification (policy unveiled September 2017 per About Us page).
portal_section: Startup Incentives (2017 scheme PDF; anchor 'Skill Development Fee Reimbursement Scheme' on home page)
notes: Scheme document under Goa Start-up Policy 2017. Goa Startup Policy 2021 section 6(b) continues the idea: reimbursement up to 50% of fees for cell-listed MOOC courses, limited to Rs 50,000 per student per year (Skill Development Fund). Goa Startup Policy 2025 replaces it with the Skill Enhancement Scheme (separate row). Read from Wayback snapshot of the PDF dated 2024-08-21.

name: Interest Subsidy Reimbursement Scheme
agency: Startup Promotion Cell (SPC), Department of Information Technology, Government of Goa
target_group: SPC-certified start-ups repaying interest on a loan
eligibility: Start-up certified by SPC with a valid certificate number; directors' bank accounts linked to Aadhaar; expenditure after notification of Goa Start-up Policy 2017, within its validity, paid digitally; apply within 6 months of incurring the expense; claim bi-annually/annually.
benefit: Up to 3 projects of immense promise recommended by SPC: grant of 30% of loan interest, up to INR 5 lakh per annum, for an initial two years. Other start-ups: 10% of loan interest, up to INR 2 lakh per year, for two years; 40 start-ups per year. In addition to any interest subsidy or loan under Chief Minister's Rojgar Yojana (CMRY). Approval/rejection within 45 days; disbursement within 60 days.
how_to_apply: Submit the application form (Annexure 1) with documents to SPC by e-mail or on the web portal.
documents: Aadhaar of Director/CEO; bank loan statement showing interest paid; no-default certificate from the bank; Annexure 1 form and documents.
valid_period: Goa Start-up Policy 2017: three years from notification (policy unveiled September 2017 per About Us page).
portal_section: Startup Incentives (2017 scheme PDF listed in sitemap)
notes: Implements Goa Start-up Policy 2017 cl. 5.4.1(c)-(d), which also says all Goa start-ups are eligible for an interest-subsidised loan from the Government under modified CMRY norms. Not carried into the 2021 or 2025 policies and no HTML scheme page exists on the portal. Read from Wayback snapshot of the PDF dated 2020-11-26.

name: Matching Grant Scheme
agency: Startup Promotion Cell (SPC), Department of Information Technology, Government of Goa
target_group: SPC-certified start-ups that raise funds from a registered/recognised funding source before product launch
eligibility: Start-up certified by SPC with a valid certificate number; product not previously available in the market; apply 1-3 months before product launch; directors' bank accounts linked to Aadhaar; expenditure after notification of Goa Start-up Policy 2017, paid digitally.
benefit: 25% matching funds, up to INR 25 lakh, against funds raised from a registered/recognised source prior to product launch, taken at proportionate ownership of stock after SPC due diligence; 20 start-ups per year. Approval/rejection within 45 days; disbursement within 60 days.
how_to_apply: Submit the application form (Annexure 1) with documents to SPC by e-mail or on the web portal, at any time of the financial year.
documents: Complete business model canvas; Aadhaar of Director/CEO; bank certificate of funds received; details/registration certificate of the funding agency; term sheet or funding instrument; Annexure 1 form.
valid_period: Goa Start-up Policy 2017: three years from notification (policy unveiled September 2017 per About Us page).
portal_section: Startup Incentives (2017 scheme PDF listed in sitemap)
notes: Implements Goa Start-up Policy 2017 cl. 5.4.1(e) (Idea-to-PoC Fund). The 2021 and 2025 policies replace it with the Venture Capital 'Fund of Funds' (separate row). Read from Wayback snapshot of the PDF dated 2020-11-26.

name: Stamp Duty Reimbursement Scheme
agency: Startup Promotion Cell (SPC), Department of Information Technology, Government of Goa
target_group: SPC-certified start-ups and SPC-enlisted incubators/accelerators purchasing or leasing land/developed area
eligibility: Start-up certified by SPC, or incubator/accelerator enlisted with SPC; once in a lifetime; directors' bank accounts linked to Aadhaar; expenditure from one year before notification of Goa Start-up Policy 2017, within its validity, paid digitally; incubators/accelerators paid after three years of successful operation (relaxable for companies in the business of making incubators); up to 100 start-ups per year.
benefit: Stamp duty on land/built-up area lease or sale for start-ups/incubators/accelerators capped at INR 100; the excess paid to authorities is reimbursed. Approval/rejection within 45 days; disbursement within 60 days.
how_to_apply: Submit the application form (Annexure 1) with documents to SPC by e-mail or on the web portal.
documents: Copy of transaction deed; original proof of payment; copy of MoU (incubators/accelerators only); Annexure 1 form.
valid_period: Goa Start-up Policy 2017: three years from notification (policy unveiled September 2017 per About Us page).
portal_section: Startup Incentives (2017 scheme PDF listed in sitemap)
notes: Implements Goa Start-up Policy 2017 cl. 5.4.1(a) (One-time Grant Fund). Not in the 2021/2025 startup policies; a parallel Registration & Stamp Duty Scheme 2018 exists for IT units (separate row). Read from Wayback snapshot of the PDF dated 2020-11-26.

name: Women Entrepreneur Vitality Scheme (monthly allowance for women-founded startups)
agency: Startup and IT Promotion Cell (SITPC), Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communications, Government of Goa
target_group: Startups founded by women at idea/prototype/validation/early-traction stage working in emerging technologies (AI, IoT, drones, robotics, AR/VR, AVGC, 3D printing etc.)
eligibility: Woman entrepreneur = legally recognised owner/operator, one of the founders/directors and a key decision-maker; startup at ideation, prototype/MVP, validation or early-traction stage in emerging technologies; the associated incubator/accelerator must submit quarterly reports to SITPC. General 2025 conditions: startup definition (10 years, INR 100 crore turnover cap, Pvt Ltd/LLP/partnership), in operation at least three months before registration.
benefit: Monthly allowance of INR 20,000 for up to one year (one-time assistance package, maximum disbursement period 12 months) under a dedicated mentoring and funding programme for women entrepreneurs; approval by SITPC itself to expedite disbursement.
how_to_apply: Through the SITPC single-window portal (www.startup.goa.gov.in / Goa Online); operational guidelines to be issued by SITPC within one year of policy notification.
documents: Not stated in the policy; quarterly reports from the associated incubator/accelerator in a format defined by SITPC.
valid_period: Goa Startup Policy 2025: three years from date of notification in the Official Gazette (date not stated in the PDF). SITPC to roll out operational guidelines for each incentive within one year of notification.
notes: max_rupees is the stated monthly figure (INR 20,000 per month, up to 12 months). Predecessor in Goa Startup Policy 2021 cl. 5.4.1(i): women-founded startups at idea stage received Rs 22,000 per month for one year plus marketing/technology support assistance up to Rs 10 lakh, maximum 40 women startups per year (Women Entrepreneurs Development Fund). No HTML scheme page or Apply link on the portal. Read from Wayback snapshot of Goa-Startup-Policy-2025.pdf dated 2026-01-18.

name: Campus Innovation Scheme
agency: Startup and IT Promotion Cell (SITPC), Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communications, Government of Goa

name: Land / Built Up Area Rebate Scheme, 2018
agency: Department of Information Technology, Government of Goa (Empowered Committee / Due Diligence Committee under Goa IT Policy 2018)
target_group: IT units buying land or built-up office space in Goa
eligibility: New and Existing IT Units with operations in Goa, constituted as a Proprietorship, Private Limited, Public Limited, Registered Partnership or LLP; registered with DoIT under Goa IT Policy 2018 (common application form Part 1). Units availing similar incentives under any other Goa policy are not eligible. Benefits subject to budgetary allocation. Existing units may claim for transactions up to 3 years before policy notification; new units for transactions after notification.
benefit: One-time rebate on land purchase of INR 40,000 per male employee (INR 50,000 per female employee) up to 60% of land cost, maximum INR 1.5 crore; or one-time rebate up to 20% of the cost of built-up office space, maximum INR 1 crore; one option per unit; employment proportional to space (up to 80 sq ft per employee) with employees on rolls 12 months; paid in three tranches after commercial operation. Disbursed pro-rata by share of Goan-origin employees or Goan graduates on rolls for at least one year: up to 30% of employees = 50% of incentive, 30-60% = 75%, above 60% = 100%.
how_to_apply: Submit Common Application Form (Part 1) with documents by e-mail or on the web portal to obtain a unit registration number from DoIT; then Common Application Form (Part 2) plus incentive-specific forms to the Due Diligence Committee; claims quarterly/bi-annually/annually after incurring expenditure. Timeline: scrutiny D+30 days, Empowered Committee approval D+60 days, sanction/regret and disbursement D+90 days.
documents: Common Application Form with all supporting documents; Application form for units (Annexure 1); Declaration form for units (Annexure 2).
valid_period: Five years from Gazette notification of the scheme (scheme framed under Goa IT Policy 2018, notified 18/07/2018, No. 2(15)/DOIT/2017-18/Goa IT Policy-2018/624).
notes: Scheme for IT industry units under the Goa Information Technology Policy and Roadmap 2018, listed on the Startup Goa portal under Notifications ('Information Technology Policy Schemes 2018'); SITPC processes applications under the IT Policy as well as the Startup Policy.
